decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that includes LIVE_EVENT_USE, RETAIL_SHOP_USE, and VISUAL_DESIGN; no additional update or removal is required.
The machine's broader visual role at events and in a shop is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message scope MODIFY.
The candidate already has a same-message scope MODIFY covering event, shop, and visual-design contexts; the source does not change any color or finish value.
The general desire for a fun visual feature does not necessarily change the placard's text, position, orientation, display sides, or established branding scope.
Mentioning the green power button while asking about base dimensions does not change the cursive E marking requirement or its lettering attributes.
The source changes the intended contexts of decorative lighting and visual presentation, not bowl removal or swapping behavior.
The visual-use context statement does not change whisk removability, removal speed, tooling preference, or sanitation scope.
The source discusses the machine's visual role and base dimensions, without changing any mixing-quality or foam requirement.

The source's visual-use statement and questions about the base do not change the spout's appearance reference, material, fabrication method, or scope.
